meal.title: Show results with f‑strings in Rock‑Paper‑Scissors
meal.objective: Embed variables inside a printed message using an f‑string

voice.script: Want to see exactly what each player chose? How can we include the choices in the result message? An f‑string lets you embed variables directly inside a string. Now we print the full result with an f‑string: Running this prints a line that shows both choices and the outcome. Use f‑strings to create clear, dynamic messages. Try changing the message to include a friendly emoji description.
